highlights_headline: SkiaSharp now initializes its shared hash-code seed from the operating system's cryptographic random-number generator.
highlights_body: The shared implementation also serves HarfBuzzSharp. Hash codes remain stable within a process and randomized between processes.

bullets.detail: The shared HashCode implementation in SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp uses RandomNumberGenerator instead of System.Random for its per-process seed. First use now loads System.Security.Cryptography; hash codes remain stable within the process.

contributor_summaries.rolfbjarne: Replaced the shared hash-code seed generator with cryptographic randomness and added analyzer safeguards for shipped code.
